title: Smoky Almond Pesto Spaghetti with Peas
changes_from_base: A raw almond, basil and parsley pesto with smoked paprika replaces the cooked tomato sauce, with sweet peas cooked in with the pasta.
summary: Spaghetti and sweet peas coated in a bright basil and parsley pesto made with almonds and smoked paprika, sharpened with lemon.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 4 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: basil leaves, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pesto
steps.text: Pulse the almonds and garlic in the processor until finely chopped. Add the basil, parsley, Parmesan and smoked paprika, then pour in the oil with the motor running until thick and well blended. The paprika gives the smoky flavour of smoked almonds while letting you use plain ones. Scrape into the bowl and stir in the lemon juice, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in 3 litres salted water until al dente, adding the frozen peas for the last minute. Save a mug of the water and drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the pasta, peas and about 120 ml of the water to the pesto and toss until every strand is coated, loosening with more water if you like.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide between bowls with extra basil.

tips: Add the lemon juice after blending to keep the herbs green.
Smoked almonds work in place of the paprika if you can find them.
The pesto keeps 3 days in the fridge under a film of oil.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
